messages:
toni: FYI i sketched a compact 'Shortcuts' rail that sits above the main nav. goal: let users pin deep-links and preserve UI micro-state in the URL (so teams can share precise views). looking for input on routing, back-button behaviour, and copy

mai: curious: by micro-state you mean tabs / panel open/closed? how granular are we planning to be with the URL?

toni: yep. example: /models/m-42#insights?panel=latency&filter=nightly — hash holds ephemeral UI state, query keeps shareable filters. main route stays canonical so server-side routing unaffected

jordan: implementation nit: hashes don't get sent to server so they're safe for ephemeral UI but not for analytics. if we want shareable links that show up in dashboards we should mirror critical state into query params too (or record an ephemeral share token)

pat: UX thought: if people pin a shortcut to a panel (e.g., model insights > latency) we should visually indicate that the shortcut contains an anchor and maybe show a small tooltip with the full path on hover so users know what they'll land on

lee: accessibility: when a shortcut navigates via hash change, we need to manage focus. focus the main H1 or the revealed panel heading and make sure a live-region announces the context change for screenreader users

mai: back-button complexity: if we push every tab change as a history entry it clutters the user's back stack. proposal: only push when a shortcut is activated or when the user explicitly selects 'Share view' — treat normal tab swaps as non-history UI updates

toni: i like that. keep history light. for shareable permalinks we can generate a canonical URL that includes query params and copy to clipboard

jordan: also think about restoring collapsed sidebar state per-org. small teams might prefer compact by default while enterprise orgs want persistent expanded; we should store preference in profile + reflect as ?sidebar=collapsed or via org settings API

pat: copy nudge: label the shortcuts area 'Shortcuts' (concise). tooltip: 'Pin a view for quick access and sharing'. for items that refer to ephemeral panels, append '• panel' in the tooltip so it's clear

lee: a11y checklist: focus management, visible focus ring on shortcut chips, aria-pressed for toggles, aria-current when a pinned item matches the current page, and ensure keyboard ordering is logical (shortcuts then nav)

jordan: routing contract draft: keep primary resource paths stable (/models/:id, /deployments/:id). use hash for transient UI (#panel=metrics), use query when we want server-visible state (?range=30d). shortcuts can include both: /models/15?range=90d#panel=insights

mai: QA/e2e: add tests for shareable links landing state, hash-only navigation for screenreaders, and back-button behaviour after activating pinned shortcut. also test copying permalink generates the expected query/hash combo

toni: will update the figma frames and PR with examples and the QA checklist. attaching a couple of sample links in the proto:```
/models/m-15
/models/m-15?range=30d#panel=training
/deployments/d-4#instances?filter=failed
```

design-bot: figma updated: https://figma.redwood/shortcuts-rail-v1 (comments enabled) :sparkles:

pat: one more thing — analytics: capture whether a view was reached via shortcut vs nav click so product can see adoption. event props: source: shortcut|nav, pinId (if available), orgId

toni: good call. i'll add instrumentation notes to the PR and mark the routing RFC as draft. thanks all :raised_hands:
